title.note: Game title, glossary keep; Turkish players search the English title (guide).

hud.cast.note: Fishing idiom "olta atmak" (cast a line); a bare "At" would also read as "horse". 7/8.

hud.reel.note: "Çek!" (pull) is what you call out when a fish bites; same verb as the pass Otomatik Çekme. "Sar" (wind in) is the alternative if a native reviewer prefers the reel sense.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form; a Turkish noun after a number stays singular anyway, so 0, 1 and 12 all read right.

hud.backpack.note: Roblox's own "Sırt Çantası" is 12, over the 10 budget; plain "Çanta" per the guide.

catch.success.note: Both params stay bare: the fish is an indefinite object, so it takes no case suffix, and Turkish adjectives never agree. Reads "Nadir Altın Sazan yakaladın!". No "bir", per the guide's egg.hatched pattern.

catch.escaped.note: "It" made explicit as the generic "balık" (fish), per context.

catch.new_record.note: For the developer: {weight} arrives as "12.4"; Turkish (TDK) writes "12,4" and uses the period as the thousands separator, so format the number for tr.

fish.golden_carp.note: sazan = carp. "altın" is also the coin word, but as an adjective before a fish it plainly means golden.

fish.lantern_eel.note: fener = lantern, yılan balığı = eel (TDK writes it as two words); follows the real "fener balığı" (anglerfish) naming. Exactly 18/18; fallback "Fener Yılanbalığı" (17) if the card is tight.

rarity.mythic.note: "Mitik" is the usual game word (Brawl Stars TR); Legendary = "Efsanevi". Brawl Stars ranks Mitik below Efsanevi, so this game's tier order and colors must show it as higher. "Mitolojik" is the alternative.

shop.equip.note: "Kuşan" is the common game-UI word for Equip in Turkish; "Kullan" (use) would also work for a rod.

shop.equipped.note: State label paired with the button "Kuşan". "Kullanılıyor" (in use) is plainer but 12, over 11.

shop.free.note: 8/8; "Bedava" (6) is the casual fallback if the label font runs wide.

shop.buy_robux.note: Price in the dative as Roblox writes it ("Robux'a"), per the guide. 17/20 without the price.

pass.auto_reel.note: Same verb as hud.reel (Çek) as a noun phrase, 14/14. "Oto Çekme" (9) if it must be shorter, though the guide avoids abbreviations in titles. Match the Creator Hub pass name.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Şanslı Yem nadir balık yakalama şansını ikiye katlar!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Lucky Bait = Şanslı Yem (luck = şans, Bait = yem). "şansını" carries "your"; "yakalama" (catching) added because Turkish needs it for "rare fish chance". Tags kept on the pass name.

sell.done.note: Two clauses keep both numbers bare before singular nouns, so 1 reads right. If the game formats thousands as "1,250" it should be "1.250" for tr.

sell.prompt.note: Guide pattern "E'ye bas" (E read as the letter); "E tuşuna bas" makes 24, over 21. Source-side issue stands: touch and console players have no E key.

ascend.button.note: "Yüksel" = rise up, as in rising in rank; not climbing ("tırman") and not religious. Same verb in ascend.confirm. Some Turkish players know "Prestij" from shooters; native check suggested.

ascend.confirm.text: Şimdi yükselmek ister misin? Baştan başlarsın ama nadir balıkları %{bonus} daha sık yakalarsın.
ascend.confirm.note: Same verb as ascend.button; percent sign before the number ("%25"), per TDK. "Baştan başlarsın" = you start over (rods and coins reset).

weather.storm.text: Fırtına yaklaşıyor! Nadir balıklar oltaya geliyor.
weather.storm.note: "oltaya gelmek" is the fishing idiom for biting; same phrase as tip.night. "yaklaşıyor" (approaching) avoids repeating "geliyor".

quest.catch_n.note: Moonlit Bay = "Ay Işığı Koyu" (built like "Ay Işığı Sonatı"); a fixed place name, so the suffix follows an apostrophe per TDK ("Ağrı Dağı'nda"). In-world signs should match. {n} stays bare before a singular noun.

friends.boost.note: Statement, not an order; percent sign before the number per TDK, "+" kept.

trade.sent.note: Name after a colon so it takes no suffix (guide pattern).
trade.sent.blind_remark: {player} is only implied to be the recipient by the colon

trade.accept.note: {player} is the subject, no suffix; "isteğini" = your request, matching "Takas isteği" in trade.sent.

codes.redeemed.note: "keyfini çıkar" = enjoy; "kullanıldı" matches the guide's redeem word "Kullan".

afk.kicked.text: Çok uzun süre hareketsiz kaldığın için balık tutman durdu.
afk.kicked.note: "balık tutma durdu" = your fishing stopped, as the source says; no mention of leaving the server. "balık tutmayı bıraktın" would sound as if the player chose to stop.
afk.kicked.review_reason: "balık tutma durdu" drops the possessive and reads like a status label spliced onto a sen-clause; "kaldığın için ... balık tutman durdu" makes it the player's fishing and states the cause naturally.

event.ends.note: "Kalan süre" (time left) keeps {time} after a colon; "Etkinlik bitiyor: {time}" is 17, over 14. For the developer: {time} arrives as "2d 4h"; "d" and "h" mean nothing in Turkish, which wants "2g 4sa".

daily.streak.text: {day} günlük seri! Daha fazla ödül için yarın yine gel.
daily.streak.note: "{day} günlük seri" = a {day}-day streak; the suffix sits on "gün", so 1 reads right. "for more" made explicit as "daha fazla ödül" (more rewards), per context.

tip.night.text: İpucu: Bazı balıklar sadece geceleri oltaya gelir.
tip.night.note: "oltaya gelmek" = bite (fishing sense), as in weather.storm. Capital after the colon because a full sentence follows (TDK).

group.join.note: "Grubumuza" (our group): it is the studio's group, as in the guide's reference. "kazan" (get) added because Turkish needs a verb for "for 50 free bait".

leaderboard.biggest.note: Ranked by weight, so "En Ağır Balık" (heaviest fish) rather than the vaguer "En Büyük Av" (biggest catch).
